title: Thesaurus (printed or online)
subject: English
source: Written for english/y6 lesson 82 (Thesaurus (printed or online))
intro: Lesson 82: Precise adjectives and figurative language for character. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Not this
This
rows: She had a nice smile and nice eyes.
Her smile was warm and unhurried; her eyes were watchful, missing nothing.

keywords.def: the ideas or feelings a word suggests

questions.q: Write a metaphor for a reliable friend
questions.a: For example: She is my lighthouse.

questions.q: Choose the most precise: walked, went, trudged (tired)

questions.a: For example: Worry tapped at his shoulder.

questions.q: Core: rewrite a plain description using four precise words and two figurative devices
Extend: explain the connotations of two words you chose
questions.a: For example: unhurried suggests calm and patience

questions.q: Stretch: write a sentence where a metaphor works on two levels
questions.a: For example: She was the root of our family: hidden, but holding us all.

questions.q: Which word suggests a person is careful with money in a GOOD way?
questions.a: A) thrifty. thrifty has positive connotations; stingy and mean are negative.
